light-paths-v1.title: Light Paths
light-paths-v1.skill: Predict reflections and steer a beam through targets
levels: Turn the mirror to shine the light on the star.
Place a mirror in the dotted mount. Send the beam around the rock.
Turn both mirrors. Follow the beam around the corner.
Shine through the lantern on the way to the star.
Light every lantern, then reach the star. Check each turn.

bridges-v1.title: Bridges and Crossings
bridges-v1.skill: Match bridge length and direction to gaps between banks
levels: Choose a plank on the marked water square. Join the two banks.
Choose a bridge long enough to cross both water squares.
Build two crossings. One bridge must run up and down.
Match a short bridge and a long bridge to the two gaps.
Cross to the island, then turn and bridge the wide inlet.

delivery-routes-v1.title: Delivery Routes
delivery-routes-v1.skill: Arrange directional commands and predict a route through stops
levels: Set the arrow to guide the courier to the flag.
Set the direction at each arrow, then press Go.
Collect the parcel before reaching the flag.
Choose the turns that collect both parcels.
Collect every parcel. Watch each arrow as the courier follows it.

gears-motion-v1.title: Gears and Motion
gears-motion-v1.skill: Connect touching gears and predict their rotation
levels: Place a gear on the empty peg. Turn the crank to drive the flower.
Place the gears so each touches the next.
Connect the crank to the spinner. Look for touching teeth.
Connect the gears. Tap the crank to match the arrow on the flower.
Build a gear chain, then choose the crank direction that turns the flower the way shown.

gates-switches-v1.title: Gates and Switches
gates-switches-v1.skill: Predict how linked switches change a path
levels: Tap the circle switch to open the matching gate. Help your friend reach the flag.
Find both circle gates. What changes when you flip the circle switch?
Use the circle and triangle switches to open their matching gates.
This gate has two locks. Turn on both switches to open it.
Follow the path. Open the gates and the double lock to reach the flag.
